notes.title: TANKBOX Patch Notes
notes.notes:
- Fixed a somewhat rare hardware specific graphical issue.
- Multiplayer co-op now starts you with 2 lives instead of 1. Additionally new lives are now rewarded every 10 stages instead of 20.
- You can now pause while the intro music is still playing.

notes.title: TANKBOX Patch Notes
notes.notes: - Added ability to set custom preview image on Workshop campaigns.

notes.title: TANKBOX Patch Notes
notes.notes:
- The AI are now slightly more wary of their comrades' bullets.

- Added a Top-Down view mode.

- Windowed mode now shows the window border.

notes.title: TANKBOX Patch Notes
notes.notes: - Fixed network multiplayer having issues when connecting to the same player a second time.

notes.title: TANKBOX Patch Notes
notes.notes: - Fixed rare crash related to a very inconsistent network connection.

notes.title: TANKBOX Patch Notes
notes.notes:
- Three new hats were added, which are awarded for the achievements "Return To Sender", "Night Mode" and "Minefield".

Hat updates:

     Mine Launcher:
          - Minelets are no longer proximity based, requiring the player to manually arm them.
          - The AI no longer avoid the minelets.
          - Speed boost buffed from 7.5% to 17.5%
          - Minelet lifetime increased by 50%.

     Earmuffs:
          - Awarded with the achievement "Edge Hit" instead of "Minefield".

     Sword:
          - Now also awarded for completing mission 50 in addition to the previous achievement.

- Fixed mines placed over the network being slightly quieter than normal.

notes.title: TANKBOX Demo Update
notes.notes:
- Updated demo to support the fixed SDL for Windows 11 and extended the demo to level 11.

- Updated music in the demo to the current version.

notes.title: TANKBOX Patch Notes
notes.notes: - Updated SDL to version 2.0.16 to fix horrible performance on Windows 11.

notes.title: TANKBOX: Workshop Update
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40569336/8a1829823e8b9b44b89b3c15811a84167e3ec38a.png[/img]

[h3]To celebrate the release of the workshop update, we're putting the game on sale all week![/h3]

- Users can now make their own campaigns, with workshop support.

- All the music tracks have been updated, courtesy of BigKitty1011!

- Added a mode where the cursor is centered on your bullets, it also lightens the bullet shadows. In addition the default shadows are now not as dark.

- Champion (beat the game without losing a life) now works over network cooperative play.

- Made it slightly easier to block bullets in the air.

- Updated the Classic campaign to be more accurate.

- Purple tanks dodge slightly less at a rate of 70%, down from 75%.

- Made it rarer for the random levels to have multiple stationary tanks.

- Fixed network co-op partner having their hat missing in the first level.

- You can now change your gameplay sensitivity.

- Fixed the box lid sides being weird in orthogonal.

- Fixed being able to continue in certain scenarios where you should not be able to.

notes.title: TANKBOX Patch Notes
notes.notes:
- Reverted an accidental change to the movement system. Moving while turning is now easier again (Accidentally was set to 45 degrees instead of 90).

- Increased vibrancy of death plasters.

notes.title: TANKBOX Patch Notes
notes.notes:
- All tank deaths now count towards the player in solo.

- Changed Maps:
   [list]
[*]Removed Course and Drinking Bird.
[*]Updated Waves, Secret Tunnel, Bottle, Freezer (P2), Highway, Roundabout.
[*]Moved Corners to be level 40.
[/list]
- New Maps:
        [list]
[*]Two-Fold - Level 30.
[*]Face - Level 90.
[/list]
- Black tanks now will try to be more aggressive in certain scenarios, they also dodge slightly more but have a harder time turning.


We are also currently working on the campaign editor and fleshing out the map editor, it should be ready soon.

notes.title: TANKBOX Patch Notes
notes.notes:
- Updated SSG to have no bounces and reduce bullet limit to 4. There is also now a slight spread.

- Added achievements/stats for direct and indirect hits; these reward the SSG and sniper scope hats as well as the previous achievements.

- Warped hat no longer grants infinite lives past level 20.

notes.title: TANKBOX Patch Notes
notes.notes:
- The sniper hat now turns your bullets into missiles that ricochet twice off walls, but limits you to a stock of 2 instead of 5.

- Fixed friction on all tanks being higher than intended; it was up to ~2x higher depending on your framerate.

- The sword hat now grants the user 2x friction.

- Added a new achievement "Night Mode".

notes.title: TANKBOX Patch Notes
notes.notes: - Increased hitbox of the sword hat and changed the sword blade to match player 1 and 2 tank colors.

notes.title: TANKBOX Patch Notes
notes.notes:
- Increased the hit radius for the mines, also the AI are now more conscious about shooting comrades within a mine's explosion radius.

- The mine launcher hat now arms all its grounded minelets with the press of right mouse button. It also now gives a slight mobility boost.

- Pressing the left mouse button with the sword hat now makes you charge forwards.

- Fixed regression where player tank unintentionally instantly stopped when no inputs were held.

- Level names are now shown.

notes.title: TANKBOX Patch Notes
notes.notes:
- Added a mine launcher hat that is awarded with the "Out of the Sandbox" achievement.

- Changed "Courtyard" (Level 11) to have more cover.

- When converting to a single player game the client now explicitly leaves the steam lobby.

notes.title: TANKBOX Patch Notes
notes.notes:
- Allowed shaders to be shared.

- Fixed incorrect coloring on Aquamarine bullet.

notes.title: TANKBOX Patch Notes
notes.notes:
- Random starting editor map now picks from the TANKBOX campaign instead of classic.

- Added the option to restart in the pause menu (hold to activate).

notes.title: Try The TANKBOX Demo With A Friend!
notes.notes: The TANKBOX demo is now available, including the first 5 levels of the TANKBOX campaign of which can be played in online or local co-op with a friend.

notes.title: TANKBOX Patch Notes
notes.notes: - Nerfed purple dodge rate from 90% (9/10 bullets) to 75% (3/4 bullets).

notes.title: TANKBOX Patch Notes
notes.notes:
- Added a game options sub-menu in the play menu, this is where you can switch the campaign mode now.

- Added option to set your own negative lives scaling in the sandbox.

- Lowered the requirement for the achievement 'More Gun' and 'Minefield'.

- Warped hat no longer allows a network co-op partner to get awarded achievements.

notes.title: TANKBOX: Campaign Update
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40569336/db4981f454f560a999d79e6ba8f5d30729296768.png[/img]

A campaign of 100 new levels (The old campaign is now in 'classic' mode).

3 new tanks.

Fixed local co-op Player 2 score not counting.
